rows.label: seed-a
rows.corner: 125C, actual positive widths -20%; actual GND tracks -20%, native filled plane/spokes; assumed 35um sheet / 20um barrel
rows.limitations: Seed-b shorts and XIN opens prevent operation. Modelled network resistance excludes cross-net shorts, so it is diagnostic only; no real-board voltage guarantee. Native GND plane/spoke etch tolerances and guaranteed material minima not established.
